answer.reason: The verses state a few deeds of this Levite: he played the harp before the ark, served as doorkeeper for it, and drew the south gate by lot.

clauses.english: played the harp in the service before the ark of God
clauses.quote: with harps on the Sheminith to excel

clauses.english: was appointed a doorkeeper for the ark as it was brought up
clauses.quote: Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

clauses.english: received the south gate by lot, and his sons the house of Asuppim
clauses.quote: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

doubts: 1CH 15:25 and 2CH 25:24 mention a house of Obededom, probably the Gittite who housed the ark, and 2CH 25:24 names an Obededom guarding the temple treasures; the record may or may not be the same man, so these verses were left out.
1CH 16:5 lists an Obededom among those ministering before the ark, but it is unclear whether he is this record or a namesake, so it was not cited.
